The text contains a clear internal inconsistency. The initial premise states that the smartphone is waterproof and encourages underwater photos, but the troubleshooting section warns against water exposure. These two statements are logically contradictory, as a device cannot be both waterproof (implying it can withstand water) and void its warranty upon any water exposure (implying it is not waterproof). This contradiction creates confusion regarding the product's actual capabilities.

The capital of France is Paris.
